facts.fact: The ministry (MPTEN) says Congo is committing to develop a national digital architecture whose interoperability layer, X-Road, is to link the information systems of the Interior, Justice, Finance, Health and Higher Education ministries, with no stated go-live or connection count; the page has no date, so 2026-09 is its published date.
facts.system: X-Road (interoperability layer of the national DPI architecture)
